home.title: Welcome to Aurora
home.subtitle: One codebase, running on web and Android.

welcome.headline: Food, cycle and mood, understood together.
welcome.body: Aurora is a calm, everyday companion for home-cooked meals, your cycle and how you feel, built for kitchens in Bangladesh.
welcome.foodBody: Log the dal, bhaat and torkari you actually cook, and see what's in them.
welcome.cycleBody: Keep track of your period and get to know your cycle, at your own pace.
welcome.moodBody: Notice how what you eat and where you are in your cycle relate to how you feel.
welcome.step1: Answer a few quick questions about your goals and kitchen.
welcome.step2: Try logging a sample meal to see how it works.
welcome.step3: Create your account and set your starting baseline.
welcome.privacyBody: Your health is personal. Aurora keeps you in control of what you share.
welcome.privacyDiscreet: Discreet Mode keeps things low-key on a shared phone.
welcome.privacyChoice: You choose which features to use and what to track.
welcome.privacyOffline: Keeps working when your connection drops, and catches up later.
